claims.zh_tw: Base Specification 定義通用 NVMe 協定；Transport Specification 綁定特定傳輸，I/O Command Set Specification 擴充命令與資料結構。這是適用關係，不是協定堆疊。
claims.en: The Base Specification defines the common NVMe protocol; a Transport Specification binds it to a transport, and an I/O Command Set Specification extends commands and data structures. This is an applicability relationship, not a protocol stack.
claims.heading_en: Roles in the NVMe specification family
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §1.1.1, 文件頁 1, PDF 頁 27
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §1.1.1, printed pages 1, PDF pages 27

claims.zh_tw: 規格的 mandatory、may、optional、reserved、shall、should 各有固定語氣；詳細版保留英文 keyword，不能把 may 或 should 翻成 shall。
claims.en: The specification assigns distinct force to mandatory, may, optional, reserved, shall, and should. A summary must not strengthen may or should into shall.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §1.4.1, 文件頁 2-3, PDF 頁 28-29
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §1.4.1, printed pages 2-3, PDF pages 28-29

claims.zh_tw: 數值的解讀同時包含進位與單位；十六進位使用 h 後綴，二進位使用 b 後綴，十進位可省略 d。十進位與二進位容量前綴代表不同倍率。
claims.en: A value is interpreted together with its radix and units. Hexadecimal uses the h suffix, binary uses b, and decimal may omit d. Decimal and binary capacity prefixes represent different multipliers.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §1.4.2, 文件頁 3-5, PDF 頁 29-31
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §1.4.2, printed pages 3-5, PDF pages 29-31

claims.zh_tw: NVMe 以 byte、word、dword 表示欄位位置；一個 word 為 2 bytes，一個 dword 為 4 bytes。解欄位時先確認 byte 與 bit 編號。
claims.en: NVMe expresses field locations in bytes, words, and dwords. A word is two bytes and a dword is four bytes; field decoding starts by confirming byte and bit numbering.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §1.4.3, 文件頁 5, PDF 頁 31
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §1.4.3, printed pages 5, PDF pages 31

claims.zh_tw: PCIe memory-based model 把 Submission Queue 與 Completion Queue 配置在記憶體。多個 I/O Submission Queues 可共用一個 I/O Completion Queue；Admin queue pair 維持一對一。
claims.en: In the PCIe memory-based model, Submission and Completion Queues reside in memory. Multiple I/O Submission Queues may share an I/O Completion Queue, while the Admin queue pair remains one-to-one.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §2.1, 文件頁 21-23, PDF 頁 47-49
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §2.1, printed pages 21-23, PDF pages 47-49

claims.zh_tw: 儲存模型用 NVM subsystem、domain、Endurance Group、NVM Set／Reclaim Group、Reclaim Unit 與 namespace 表達包含關係。namespace 是 host 實際透過 controller 存取的格式化容量。
claims.en: The storage model expresses containment through the NVM subsystem, domain, Endurance Group, NVM Set or Reclaim Group, Reclaim Unit, and namespace. A namespace is the formatted capacity a host accesses through a controller.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §2.3.1, 文件頁 26-33, PDF 頁 52-59
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §2.3.1, printed pages 26-33, PDF pages 52-59

claims.zh_tw: Admin Command Set 管理 controller 與 queue；I/O Command Set 定義對 namespace 的資料操作。Base 說明通用機制，個別 I/O Command Set Specification 說明命令語意。
claims.en: The Admin Command Set manages controllers and queues; an I/O Command Set defines data operations on namespaces. Base describes common mechanisms, while each I/O Command Set Specification describes command semantics.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §2.3.2, 文件頁 33, PDF 頁 59
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §2.3.2, printed pages 33, PDF pages 59

claims.zh_tw: controller、port、namespace 與 PCI Function 是不同物件；NSID 是 controller 用來指向 namespace 的 handle，不是 namespace 本身。
claims.en: Controllers, ports, namespaces, and PCI Functions are distinct objects. An NSID is a controller-visible handle for a namespace, not the namespace itself.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §2.3.3, 文件頁 33-35, PDF 頁 59-61
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §2.3.3, printed pages 33-35, PDF pages 59-61

claims.zh_tw: multi-path I/O 是同一 host 到同一 namespace 的兩條以上獨立路徑；namespace sharing 是兩個以上 host 經不同 controller 存取同一 shared namespace。兩者都需要至少兩個 controller。
claims.en: Multi-path I/O provides two or more independent paths from one host to one namespace; namespace sharing lets two or more hosts access one shared namespace through different controllers. Both require at least two controllers.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §2.4.1, 文件頁 35-37, PDF 頁 61-63
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §2.4.1, printed pages 35-37, PDF pages 61-63

claims.zh_tw: 支援多路徑或共享時，各 controller 對同一 namespace 的存取特性不一定相同；host 可依 controller 所回報的狀態選擇路徑。
claims.en: With multi-path or sharing, controllers need not provide identical access characteristics to the same namespace; the host may select paths using the state reported by each controller.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §2.4.2, 文件頁 37, PDF 頁 63
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §2.4.2, printed pages 37, PDF pages 63

claims.zh_tw: memory-based controller 必須（shall）只支援 static controller model。
claims.en: A memory-based controller shall support only the static controller model.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.1.1, 文件頁 38, PDF 頁 64
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.1.1, printed pages 38, PDF pages 64

claims.zh_tw: 本輪只使用 I/O controller 與 Administrative controller：前者可執行使用者資料的 I/O，後者以管理為目的且不支援資料 I/O command。兩者都具有一組 Admin Submission／Completion Queue。
claims.en: This report uses the I/O and Administrative controller roles. The former performs user-data I/O; the latter is management-oriented and does not support data I/O commands. Both have one Admin Submission/Completion Queue pair.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.1.3-3.1.3.2, printed pages 39-43, PDF pages 65-69

claims.zh_tw: 除 fused operation 外，controller 取走的命令與完成沒有一般性的先後保證；若有順序需求，強制該順序是 host 的責任。
claims.en: Except for fused operations, fetched commands and completions have no general ordering guarantee. Enforcing any required order is the host's responsibility.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.1.3, 文件頁 40, PDF 頁 66
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.1.3, printed pages 40, PDF pages 66

claims.zh_tw: host 必須（shall）以 property 指定的寬度，從 property 起始 offset 存取；memory-based controller 的實際存取規則由 PCIe Transport 補充。
claims.en: The host shall access a property at its starting offset using the specified width; the PCIe Transport adds the access rules for a memory-based controller.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.1.4, 文件頁 52-54, PDF 頁 78-80
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.1.4, printed pages 52-54, PDF pages 78-80

claims.zh_tw: NSID 0h 無效，FFFFFFFFh 是 broadcast 值；其餘 NSID 還要區分 allocated／unallocated 與 active／inactive，不能只看數字是否落在範圍內。
claims.en: NSID 0h is invalid and FFFFFFFFh is the broadcast value. Other NSIDs still need allocated/unallocated and active/inactive classification; numeric range alone is insufficient.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.2.1, printed pages 78-80, PDF pages 104-106

claims.zh_tw: NVM Set、Endurance Group、Reclaim Group 與 Reclaim Unit 分別描述容量集合、耐久度管理與回收粒度。是否支援及其 identifier 由 Identify／log page 能力判定。
claims.en: NVM Sets, Endurance Groups, Reclaim Groups, and Reclaim Units describe capacity grouping, endurance management, and reclamation granularity. Support and identifiers are determined from Identify data and log-page capabilities.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.2.2-3.2.4, printed pages 80-85, PDF pages 106-111

claims.zh_tw: domain 是 NVM subsystem 內的故障／通訊邊界。多 domain subsystem 的 identifier 必須（shall）在該 subsystem 內唯一。
claims.en: A domain is a failure or communication boundary inside an NVM subsystem. In a multi-domain subsystem, each domain identifier shall be unique within that subsystem.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.2.5, printed pages 85-88, PDF pages 111-114

claims.zh_tw: PCIe queue 由 host-addressable memory 中的環形 buffer、head 與 tail pointer 構成。host 建立 I/O Completion Queue 後再建立對應 Submission Queue，並以 doorbell 推進 pointer。
claims.en: A PCIe queue is a circular buffer in host-addressable memory with head and tail pointers. The host creates an I/O Completion Queue before its Submission Queue and advances pointers through doorbells.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.3.1, printed pages 88-91, PDF pages 114-117

claims.zh_tw: command processing 要分開看 ordering、fused／atomic semantics、arbitration 與 outstanding command 上限；priority 屬於 Submission Queue，不是每一筆 command 的獨立欄位。
claims.en: Command processing separates ordering, fused and atomic semantics, arbitration, and outstanding-command limits. Priority belongs to a Submission Queue, not to each command as an independent attribute.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.4.1-3.4.5, printed pages 101-105, PDF pages 127-131

claims.zh_tw: PCIe 初始化以 CAP 判斷能力與 timeout，設定 AQA／ASQ／ACQ 與 CC，接著等待 CSTS.RDY。ready mode 與 CRTO 會影響 host 等待與錯誤處理。
claims.en: PCIe initialization reads CAP, configures AQA/ASQ/ACQ and CC, then waits for CSTS.RDY. Ready mode and CRTO affect host wait and error handling.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.5.1, 3.5.3-3.5.4, printed pages 105-113, PDF pages 131-139

claims.zh_tw: 正常 shutdown 由 host 設定 CC.SHN，controller 透過 CSTS.SHST 回報進度；NVM subsystem shutdown 是更大範圍的處理，不能與單一 controller shutdown 混為一談。
claims.en: Normal shutdown begins when the host sets CC.SHN and the controller reports progress in CSTS.SHST. NVM subsystem shutdown has a wider scope and is not the same as one controller shutdown.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.6.1, 3.6.3, printed pages 113-120, PDF pages 139-146

claims.zh_tw: NVM Subsystem Reset、Controller Level Reset 與 Queue Level Reset 的影響範圍不同；設計 recovery flow 前先確認哪一層狀態會被清除、queue 是否仍存在。
claims.en: NVM Subsystem, Controller Level, and Queue Level resets have different scopes. A recovery flow first determines which state is cleared and whether queues still exist.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.7, printed pages 120-125, PDF pages 146-151

claims.zh_tw: capacity model 分開追蹤 NVM subsystem、Endurance Group、NVM Set 與 namespace 的可用或配置容量；同一數值不可跨層級直接比較。
claims.en: The capacity model tracks available or configured capacity separately at subsystem, Endurance Group, NVM Set, and namespace levels. Values from different levels are not directly interchangeable.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.8, printed pages 125-129, PDF pages 151-155

claims.zh_tw: Keep Alive 以 KATO／KATT 建立 host 與 controller 的存活監測；本報告只保留 controller 共通與 PCIe 可用的 timer、command 與 timeout 行為。
claims.en: Keep Alive uses KATO and KATT for host/controller liveness monitoring. This report retains only controller-common and PCIe-applicable timer, command, and timeout behavior.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.9, printed pages 129-135, PDF pages 155-161

claims.zh_tw: privileged action 會影響其他 host 或 controller；firmware update 分成 image download、commit／activate 與可能的 reset，host 依回報的 activation action 安排流程。
claims.en: A privileged action may affect other hosts or controllers. Firmware update separates image download, commit/activation, and any required reset; the host sequences the flow using the reported activation action.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.10-3.11, printed pages 135-138, PDF pages 161-164

claims.zh_tw: Admin 與 I/O common SQE 固定為 64 bytes。CDW0、NSID、data pointer 與 CDW10-15 的通用位置先固定，再由各 command 定義命令專屬內容。
claims.en: The common Admin and I/O SQE is 64 bytes. CDW0, NSID, data pointers, and CDW10-15 establish the common layout before each command defines command-specific content.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §4.1.1, printed pages 139-143, PDF pages 165-169

claims.zh_tw: CID 與 Submission Queue identifier 的組合用來唯一識別 command；FFFFh 宜（should）避免使用，因 Error Information log 以該值表示錯誤未對應特定 command。
claims.en: CID in combination with the Submission Queue identifier uniquely identifies a command. FFFFh should be avoided because the Error Information log uses it when an error is not associated with a particular command.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §4.1.1, 文件頁 140, PDF 頁 166
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §4.1.1, printed pages 140, PDF pages 166

claims.zh_tw: CDW0.PSDT 決定 DPTR 解讀為 PRP 或 SGL。NVMe over PCIe 的 Admin command 原則上必須（shall）使用 PRP，除非 command 定義另有規定。
claims.en: CDW0.PSDT selects PRP or SGL interpretation for DPTR. An Admin command over PCIe shall use PRPs unless its command definition specifies otherwise.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §4.1.1, printed pages 140-142, PDF pages 166-168

claims.zh_tw: common CQE 至少 16 bytes；若以多次寫入建立 CQE，Phase Tag 必須（shall）在最後一次寫入更新，避免 host 看到半成品。
claims.en: The common CQE is at least 16 bytes. If multiple writes construct it, the Phase Tag shall be updated in the last write so the host does not consume a partial entry.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §4.2.1, printed pages 144-145, PDF pages 170-171

claims.zh_tw: status 要先解 Status Code Type（SCT），再解 Status Code（SC），同時檢查 Do Not Retry（DNR）等控制 bit；數值不能脫離 SCT 單獨解讀。
claims.en: Status decoding starts with Status Code Type (SCT), then Status Code (SC), together with control bits such as Do Not Retry (DNR). An SC value is not interpreted without its SCT.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §4.2.3, printed pages 145-155, PDF pages 171-181

claims.zh_tw: Phase Tag 讓 host 判斷環形 Completion Queue slot 是否為新完成項目；host 消費 CQE 後推進 CQ head doorbell，wrap 時預期 phase 翻轉。
claims.en: The Phase Tag lets the host distinguish a new entry in a circular Completion Queue. After consuming CQEs, the host advances the CQ head doorbell and expects phase inversion on wrap.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §4.2.4, printed pages 155-158, PDF pages 181-184

claims.zh_tw: PRP 以固定大小 entry 指向 physical memory page。第一個 entry 可含 page offset；後續 PRP 必須（shall）符合 page alignment，資料長度決定需要幾個 entry。
claims.en: A fixed-size PRP entry points to a physical memory page. The first entry may contain a page offset; subsequent PRPs shall obey page alignment, and transfer length determines the required entry count.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §4.3.1, printed pages 158-159, PDF pages 184-185

claims.zh_tw: SGL 由一個以上 descriptor／segment 描述資料 buffer。SGL length 必須（shall）大於等於 requested transfer length；本報告只介紹 PCIe 可用的通用 descriptor。
claims.en: An SGL describes a data buffer through one or more descriptors and segments. SGL length shall equal or exceed the requested transfer length; this report covers only generic descriptors applicable to PCIe.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §4.3.2, printed pages 159-166, PDF pages 185-192

claims.zh_tw: Feature 可能具有 default、saved、current value；saved value 支援與跨 reset／power cycle 的 persistence 由 SSFS 與各 Feature capability 判定。
claims.en: A Feature may have default, saved, and current values. Saved-value support and persistence across resets or power cycles are determined from SSFS and each Feature capability.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §4.4, printed pages 166-169, PDF pages 192-195

claims.zh_tw: VID／SSVID、SN／MN、IEEE OUI、EUI64、NGUID 與 UUID 的來源、長度與唯一性範圍不同；不能只因外觀相似就互換。此節為 informative。
claims.en: VID/SSVID, SN/MN, IEEE OUI, EUI64, NGUID, and UUID differ in origin, length, and uniqueness scope and are not interchangeable. This section is informative.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §4.5, printed pages 169-172, PDF pages 195-198

claims.zh_tw: Controller List 與 Namespace List 都先給出數量，再排列 identifier；實作 parser 時，先依格式定義的上限與保留區驗證輸入。
claims.en: Controller and Namespace Lists provide a count followed by identifiers. A parser first validates the count, defined limit, and reserved area before consuming entries.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §4.6, printed pages 172-173, PDF pages 198-199

claims.zh_tw: 處理 UTF-8 輸入時要依規格流程驗證編碼、禁止的 code point 與截斷情況；不可把任意 byte sequence 當成有效字串。
claims.en: UTF-8 input processing validates encoding, prohibited code points, and truncation using the specified flow; an arbitrary byte sequence is not automatically a valid string.

claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §4.6.1, Figure 139, 文件頁 172, PDF 頁 198
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §4.6.1, Figure 139, printed pages 172, PDF pages 198

claims.zh_tw: Figure 140〈Namespace List Format〉：定義〈Namespace List Format〉的實際配置或數值關係。 依 byte／bit 順序、length、access type 與保留區閱讀；來源欄位索引：ID, Namespace。
claims.en: Figure 140, "Namespace List Format": Defines the concrete layout or value relationships for Namespace List Format. Follow byte/bit order, length, access type, and reserved areas; the source-derived evidence index is ID, Namespace.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §4.6.2, Figure 140, 文件頁 172, PDF 頁 198
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §4.6.2, Figure 140, printed pages 172, PDF pages 198

claims.zh_tw: Figure 142〈UTF-8 Input Processing〉：呈現〈UTF-8 Input Processing〉要求的輸入驗證順序。 依序執行 decoding、禁止 code point 與 truncation 檢查；來源索引：UTF。
claims.en: Figure 142, "UTF-8 Input Processing": Shows the input-validation sequence required by UTF-8 Input Processing. Follow decoding, prohibited-code-point, and truncation checks in order. Evidence index: UTF.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §4.8, Figure 142, 文件頁 175, PDF 頁 201
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §4.8, Figure 142, printed pages 175, PDF pages 201

claims.zh_tw: 同一 domain 內的 controllers 共用 firmware slots，且相同 firmware image 會套用到該 domain 的所有 controllers；若不支援 multiple domains，範圍就是整個 NVM subsystem。
claims.en: Controllers in one domain share firmware slots, and the same firmware image is applied to all controllers in that domain. If multiple domains are not supported, that scope is the entire NVM subsystem.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 先找出 firmware 的共享邊界
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.9, 文件頁 202, PDF 頁 228
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.9, printed pages 202, PDF pages 228

claims.zh_tw: 需要 reset 的標準流程是：一筆以上 Firmware Image Download、Firmware Commit 驗證並放入 slot、執行能觸發該 activation 的 Controller Level Reset，然後重新初始化 controller 與 I/O queues。
claims.en: The reset-based flow is one or more Firmware Image Download commands, Firmware Commit to validate and place the image, a Controller Level Reset capable of causing activation, and reinitialization of the controller and I/O queues.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 需要 reset 的完整流程
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.11, printed pages 135-136, PDF pages 161-162

claims.zh_tw: CA=011b 要求立即 activation。Firmware Commit 不是 background operation，會保持進行中直到 activation 成功或失敗；若 Firmware Activation notice 已啟用，受影響 controller 可（may）送出 Firmware Activation Starting event。
claims.en: CA=011b requests immediate activation. Firmware Commit is not a background operation and remains in progress until activation succeeds or fails. If Firmware Activation notices are enabled, an affected controller may send Firmware Activation Starting.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 立即 activation 不是背景工作
claims.heading_en: Immediate activation is not background work
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.11, 文件頁 136, PDF 頁 162
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.11, printed pages 136, PDF pages 162

claims.zh_tw: 若新 image 無法成功載入，controller 必須（shall）回復到最近 activation 的 slot image；若該 image 也無法載入，則載入可用的 baseline read-only image，並產生 Firmware Image Load Error event。
claims.en: If the new image cannot be loaded, the controller shall revert to the image in the most recently activated slot; if that image also cannot be loaded, it loads an available baseline read-only image and generates Firmware Image Load Error.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.11, printed pages 136-137, PDF pages 162-163

claims.zh_tw: host 不宜（should not）讓 firmware／Boot Partition update sequences 重疊，且同一 sequence 宜（should）只使用一個 controller 或 Management Endpoint。
claims.en: The host should not overlap firmware or Boot Partition update sequences and should use only one controller or Management Endpoint throughout a sequence.
claims.heading_zh_tw: update sequence 應以串行方式規劃
claims.heading_en: Plan update sequences as serialized work
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.11, 文件頁 137, PDF 頁 163
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.11, printed pages 137, PDF pages 163

claims.zh_tw: Firmware Commit 完成後的第一筆新 Firmware Image Download，以及 download 後、Firmware Commit 完成前發生的 Controller Level Reset，都必須（shall）使 controller 丟棄尚存的已下載 portions。
claims.en: The first Firmware Image Download after Firmware Commit completes, and a Controller Level Reset after download but before Firmware Commit completion, shall cause the controller to discard remaining downloaded portions.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.11, 5.2.10, printed pages 137, 205-206, PDF pages 163, 231-232

claims.zh_tw: firmware revisions 間的 UUID List 宜（should）保持 entry 位置穩定：新增 UUID 宜接在尾端；移除時宜原位改成 NVMe Invalid UUID；不宜重用 invalid entry，也不宜縮短或移除清單。
claims.en: Across firmware revisions, UUID List entry positions should remain stable: new UUIDs should be appended, a removed UUID should be replaced in place with the NVMe Invalid UUID, an invalid entry should not be reused, and the list should not be shortened or removed.
claims.heading_zh_tw: UUID List 的位置穩定性
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.11.1, printed pages 137-138, PDF pages 163-164

claims.zh_tw: 若 downloaded image 在既有 entry 中，以有效 UUID 取代 NVMe Invalid UUID 或另一個有效 UUID，controller 必須（shall）要求 reset；所有受這個 UUID List 變更影響的 controllers 都必須（shall）reset。
claims.en: If a downloaded image replaces the NVMe Invalid UUID or a different valid UUID with a valid UUID in an existing entry, the controller shall require reset, and all controllers affected by that UUID List change shall be reset.
claims.heading_zh_tw: UUID 變更造成的 reset 邊界
claims.heading_en: Reset boundary caused by UUID changes
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.11.1, 文件頁 138, PDF 頁 164
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.11.1, printed pages 138, PDF pages 164

claims.zh_tw: Identify Controller 的 FR 是目前 active firmware revision 的 8-byte ASCII string，scope 是 controller 所屬 domain；它與 LID 03h 回報的目前 revision 資訊相同。
claims.en: Identify Controller FR is the eight-byte ASCII string for the currently active firmware revision in the controller's domain. It is the same revision information available from LID 03h.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14.1, 文件頁 340, PDF 頁 366
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14.1, printed pages 340, PDF pages 366

claims.zh_tw: CTRATT.MDS 判斷 LID 03h 回傳 domain scope 還是整個 NVM subsystem scope；CTRATT.ULIST 判斷 controller 是否支援 UUID List reporting。MDS=1 時 DID 必須（shall）非零；single-domain subsystem 的 DID 必須（shall）為 0h。
claims.en: CTRATT.MDS determines whether LID 03h returns domain-scoped or NVM-subsystem-scoped information, while CTRATT.ULIST indicates UUID List reporting support. With MDS=1, DID shall be nonzero; in a single-domain subsystem, DID shall be 0h.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14.1, printed pages 346, 364, PDF pages 372, 390

claims.zh_tw: FRMW 的 SMUD、FAWR、NOFS 與 FFSRO 分別表示重疊 update 偵測、免 reset activation、domain 支援的 slot 數（1 到 7）以及 slot 1 是否 read-only。
claims.en: FRMW.SMUD, FAWR, NOFS, and FFSRO describe overlapping-update detection, activation without reset, the domain's supported slot count (1 through 7), and whether slot 1 is read-only.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14.1, 文件頁 354, PDF 頁 380
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14.1, printed pages 354, PDF pages 380

claims.zh_tw: MTFA 以 100 ms 為單位，表示 activation 時 controller 暫停處理 commands 的最長時間；支援免 reset activation 時此欄位必須（shall）有效，0h 表示最大時間未定義。
claims.en: MTFA is in 100 ms units and reports the maximum time command processing is temporarily stopped during activation. It shall be valid when activation without reset is supported; 0h means the maximum is undefined.
claims.heading_zh_tw: MTFA：暫停 command processing 的時間
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14.1, 文件頁 357, PDF 頁 383
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14.1, printed pages 357, PDF pages 383

claims.zh_tw: FWUG 以 4 KiB 為單位限制 NUMD 與 OFST 的 granularity／alignment：1h=4 KiB、2h=8 KiB、0h=未提供資訊、FFh=可用任何 dword granularity 與 alignment。違反時 controller 可（may）回 Invalid Field in Command。
claims.en: FWUG constrains NUMD and OFST granularity/alignment in 4 KiB units: 1h is 4 KiB, 2h is 8 KiB, 0h reports no information, and FFh permits any dword granularity and alignment. A controller may return Invalid Field in Command for a violation.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14.1, 文件頁 359, PDF 頁 385
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14.1, printed pages 359, PDF pages 385

claims.zh_tw: MPTFAWR 以 100 ms 為單位，估算 CA=011b 的 Firmware Commit 從處理到完成所需最大時間，且包含把 image commit 到 slot 的時間；不支援免 reset activation 時必須（shall）為 0h。
claims.en: MPTFAWR is a 100 ms-unit estimate of the maximum processing time to complete Firmware Commit with CA=011b, including time to commit the image to a slot. It shall be 0h when activation without reset is unsupported.
claims.heading_zh_tw: MPTFAWR：立即 activation 的完成時間
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14.1, 文件頁 364, PDF 頁 390
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14.1, printed pages 364, PDF pages 390

claims.zh_tw: Firmware Commit 驗證最後下載的 image、把它放入 firmware slot，並依 Commit Action 決定只放置、在後續 Controller Level Reset activation，或立即 activation。成功 commit 不等於當下已 active。
claims.en: Firmware Commit validates the last downloaded image, places it in a firmware slot, and uses Commit Action to choose placement only, activation at a later Controller Level Reset, or immediate activation. Successful commit does not by itself mean the image is currently active.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.9, printed pages 202-203, PDF pages 228-229

claims.zh_tw: CDW10[5:3] 是 CA，CDW10[2:0] 是 FS。CA 000b 只放置；001b 放置並排定下次 CLR activation；010b 排定既有 slot；011b 立即 activation。FS=0h 時 controller 必須（shall）在 slot 1 到 7 中選一個。
claims.en: CDW10[5:3] is CA and CDW10[2:0] is FS. CA 000b places only, 001b places and schedules activation at the next CLR, 010b schedules an existing slot, and 011b activates immediately. With FS=0h, the controller shall choose a slot from 1 through 7.
claims.heading_zh_tw: CA 與 FS 的決策矩陣
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.9, 文件頁 203, PDF 頁 229
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.9, printed pages 203, PDF pages 229

claims.zh_tw: BPID 與 CA=110b／111b 屬於 Boot Partition：110b 取代指定 partition，111b 將它標成 active；Boot Partition Write Prohibited 是 Firmware Commit 的 command-specific status 之一。
claims.en: BPID and CA=110b/111b belong to Boot Partition handling: 110b replaces the selected partition, 111b marks it active, and Boot Partition Write Prohibited is one of the Firmware Commit command-specific status values.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.9, printed pages 203-205, PDF pages 229-231

claims.zh_tw: Firmware Commit CQE.DW0[1:0] 的 MUD 分別回報 Management Endpoint 與 Admin Submission Queue 偵測到的 overlap。若 FRMW.SMUD=0，MUD 必須（shall）為 00b；MUD 在 command 成功或 aborted 時都有效。
claims.en: Firmware Commit CQE.DW0[1:0] MUD reports overlap detected through a Management Endpoint and an Admin Submission Queue. If FRMW.SMUD is 0, MUD shall be 00b; MUD is valid whether the command succeeds or is aborted.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.9, 文件頁 204, PDF 頁 230
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.9, printed pages 204, PDF pages 230

claims.zh_tw: Firmware Commit 的 command-specific status 區分 invalid slot／image、需要 Conventional／NVM Subsystem／Controller Level Reset、MTFA violation、activation prohibited、overlapping range、Boot Partition write prohibited 與 personality incompatibility。
claims.en: Firmware Commit command-specific status distinguishes invalid slot/image, required Conventional/NVM Subsystem/Controller Level Reset, MTFA violation, activation prohibited, overlapping range, Boot Partition write prohibition, and personality incompatibility.
claims.heading_zh_tw: status 決定下一個 recovery 動作
claims.heading_en: Status selects the next recovery action
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.9, printed pages 204-205, PDF pages 230-231

claims.zh_tw: Firmware Image Download 可分成多個 portions，firmware image portions 可不依序送達；host 宜（should）避免 ranges 重疊並符合 FWUG。Boot Partition portions 則必須（shall）依序提交。
claims.en: Firmware Image Download may split an image into portions, and firmware-image portions may arrive out of order. The host should avoid overlapping ranges and comply with FWUG. Boot Partition portions shall be submitted in order.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.10, printed pages 205-206, PDF pages 231-232

claims.zh_tw: NVMe over PCIe 的 Admin command 不得使用 SGL，因此 DPTR 以 PRP 指向本次來源 buffer；NUMD 是 0's-based dword count，所以 bytes=(NUMD+1)×4；OFST 是距 image 起點的 dword offset，所以 byte offset=OFST×4。包含 image 起點的 portion 必須（shall）令 OFST=0h。
claims.en: An Admin command over NVMe over PCIe shall not use SGL, so DPTR uses PRPs to identify the source buffer. NUMD is a zero-based dword count, so bytes=(NUMD+1)×4; OFST is a dword offset from the image start, so byte offset=OFST×4. The portion containing the image start shall use OFST=0h.
claims.heading_en: DPTR, NUMD, OFST, and actual bytes

claims.zh_tw: 讀 LID 03h 時，未使用 namespace，因此 NSID 必須（shall）為 0h；DPTR 以 PRP 指向 512-byte destination buffer。必要的 CDW10-CDW14 slice 為 LID=03h、LSP=0、RAE=0、NUMDL/NUMDU 表示 512 bytes、LSI=0、LPOL/LPOU=0、OT=0、UIDX=0；CSI 對 LID 03h 不使用，controller 依 Figure 208 規則忽略。
claims.en: When reading LID 03h, no namespace is used, so NSID shall be 0h, and DPTR uses PRPs to identify the 512-byte destination buffer. The required CDW10-CDW14 slice is LID=03h, LSP=0, RAE=0, NUMDL/NUMDU for 512 bytes, LSI=0, LPOL/LPOU=0, OT=0, and UIDX=0. LID 03h does not use CSI, which the controller ignores under Figure 208's rule.

claims.zh_tw: NUMDL 與 NUMDU 合成 0's-based dword count。LID 03h 固定 512 bytes=128 dwords，因此 NUMD=127=0000007Fh，NUMDL=007Fh、NUMDU=0000h；在 LSP=0、RAE=0 下，CDW10=007F0003h。
claims.en: NUMDL and NUMDU form a zero-based dword count. LID 03h is 512 bytes, or 128 dwords, so NUMD=127=0000007Fh, NUMDL=007Fh, and NUMDU=0000h. With LSP=0 and RAE=0, CDW10=007F0003h.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 512 bytes 的實際 command 計算
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13, printed pages 213-215, PDF pages 239-241

claims.zh_tw: RAE=0 會在 command 成功時清除對應 asynchronous event，RAE=1 則保留；若 command 未成功，controller 必須（shall）保留 event。Firmware Activation Starting event 要以 RAE=0 讀取 LID 03h 才會清除。
claims.en: RAE=0 clears the corresponding asynchronous event on successful completion, while RAE=1 retains it. If the command fails, the controller shall retain the event. Firmware Activation Starting is cleared by reading LID 03h with RAE=0.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.2, 5.2.13, printed pages 186, 213, PDF pages 212, 239

claims.zh_tw: 本報告以完整 512-byte LID 03h、LPOL=LPOU=0、OT=0 為基準。一般 byte offset 必須 dword aligned；超過 log page 大小的 offset 必須（shall）回 Invalid Field in Command。LID 03h 不需要 index-offset 分支。
claims.en: This report uses the complete 512-byte LID 03h with LPOL=LPOU=0 and OT=0. A general byte offset is dword aligned, and an offset beyond the log page shall return Invalid Field in Command. LID 03h needs no index-offset branch.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 完整讀取與 offset 邊界
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13, printed pages 214-215, PDF pages 240-241

claims.zh_tw: Figure 209 的 LID 03h row 指定 CSI=N、scope=Domain／NVM subsystem、reference=§5.2.13.1.4。MDS=1 時回傳處理 command 之 controller 所屬 domain；否則回傳整個 NVM subsystem 的資訊。
claims.en: The LID 03h row in Figure 209 specifies CSI=N, scope=Domain/NVM subsystem, and reference §5.2.13.1.4. With MDS=1, the data is for the domain containing the controller that processed the command; otherwise it is for the NVM subsystem.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13, printed pages 215-216, PDF pages 241-242

claims.zh_tw: Firmware Slot Information log page 固定 512 bytes，說明每個支援 slot 內的 firmware revision，並指出 current active slot 與（若 controller 有回報）next active slot。revision 以 ASCII string 表示。
claims.en: The 512-byte Firmware Slot Information log page reports the firmware revision stored in each supported slot and identifies the current active slot plus the next active slot when reported. Revisions are ASCII strings.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13.1.4, printed pages 225-226, PDF pages 251-252

claims.zh_tw: byte 0 的 AFI 中，NAFS=bits 6:4、CAFS=bits 2:0；bits 7 與 3 reserved。NAFS 非零表示將於下一次能觸發 activation 的 CLR 啟用該 slot，NAFS=0 表示 controller 未指出 next slot；CAFS 是目前執行 image 的來源 slot。
claims.en: In AFI byte 0, NAFS is bits 6:4 and CAFS is bits 2:0; bits 7 and 3 are reserved. Nonzero NAFS identifies the slot to activate at the next CLR capable of causing activation; NAFS=0 means no next slot is indicated. CAFS identifies the source slot of the running image.
claims.heading_en: AFI: current and next active slots
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13.1.4, printed pages 226, PDF pages 252

claims.zh_tw: FRS1 到 FRS7 位於 bytes 8-63，每格 8 bytes；slot 沒有有效 revision 或不支援時，該 FRS 必須（shall）清為 0h。bytes 1-7 與 64-511 reserved。
claims.en: FRS1 through FRS7 occupy bytes 8-63, eight bytes per slot. If a slot has no valid revision or is unsupported, its FRS shall be cleared to 0h. Bytes 1-7 and 64-511 are reserved.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13.1.4, printed pages 226, PDF pages 252

claims.zh_tw: NVMe over PCIe Transport 將 Conventional Reset 與 Function Level Reset 分別列為額外的 transport-specific Controller Level Reset 方法；除 Controller Reset 外，Controller Level Reset 會依 PCI Express Base Specification 重設 PCI register space。
claims.en: NVMe over PCIe Transport lists Conventional Reset and Function Level Reset as distinct additional transport-specific Controller Level Reset methods. Except for Controller Reset, Controller Level Reset resets PCI register space as defined by the PCI Express Base Specification.
claims.heading_zh_tw: PCIe reset 名稱不能混用
claims.heading_en: Do not conflate PCIe reset names
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-PCIE-TRANSPORT-1.4, Rev. 1.4, §3.3, 文件頁 11, PDF 頁 11
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-PCIE-TRANSPORT-1.4, Rev. 1.4, §3.3, printed pages 11, PDF pages 11

claims.zh_tw: 來源 §5.2.9 將 Firmware Revision 欄位指向 Figure 337；但 Figure 337 是 Command Set Identifiers，FR 實際列在 Figure 338。未取得另行核准的 errata，因此保留並揭露這個來源內部交叉引用差異，不靜默改寫。
claims.en: Source §5.2.9 points Firmware Revision to Figure 337, but Figure 337 contains Command Set Identifiers and FR appears in Figure 338. Without separately approved errata, this report preserves and discloses the internal source discrepancy instead of silently rewriting it.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.9, 5.2.14.1, printed pages 202, 340, PDF pages 228, 366

claims.zh_tw: Figure 187〈Firmware Commit – Command Dword 10〉：定義〈Firmware Commit – Command Dword 10〉的實際配置或數值關係。 依 byte／bit 順序、length、access type 與保留區閱讀；來源欄位索引：BPID, CA, FS。
claims.en: Figure 187, "Firmware Commit – Command Dword 10": Defines the concrete layout or value relationships for Firmware Commit – Command Dword 10. Follow byte/bit order, length, access type, and reserved areas; the source-derived evidence index is BPID, CA, FS.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.9, Figure 187, 文件頁 203, PDF 頁 229
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.9, Figure 187, printed pages 203, PDF pages 229

claims.zh_tw: Figure 188〈Firmware Commit – Completion Queue Entry Dword 0〉：呈現〈Firmware Commit – Completion Queue Entry Dword 0〉中的 queue 或 command 關係。 沿 host、SQ、controller、CQ 的擁有者與方向閱讀，並分開追蹤：MUD, MEFWO, ASQFWO。
claims.en: Figure 188, "Firmware Commit – Completion Queue Entry Dword 0": Shows the queue or command relationship expressed by Firmware Commit – Completion Queue Entry Dword 0. Trace ownership and direction from host to SQ, controller, and CQ; keep the indexed elements distinct: MUD, MEFWO, ASQFWO.

claims.zh_tw: Get Features 是讀取 Feature 屬性的 Admin command。工程流程不應從寫入猜測開始，而要先辨認 FID、查 capability，再取得 current／default／saved value。
claims.en: Get Features is the Admin command that retrieves Feature attributes. An engineering flow starts by identifying the FID, querying capability, and retrieving current/default/saved values instead of guessing before a write.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 先讀後寫：Feature 能力盤點
claims.heading_en: Read before write: Feature capability inventory
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.12, 文件頁 209, PDF 頁 235
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.12, printed pages 209, PDF pages 235

claims.zh_tw: CDW10.SEL 選擇 current=000b、default=001b、saved=010b 或 supported capabilities=011b；CDW10.FID 選 Feature。其餘 SEL encoding reserved。
claims.en: CDW10.SEL selects current=000b, default=001b, saved=010b, or supported capabilities=011b; CDW10.FID selects the Feature. Other SEL encodings are reserved.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.12, printed pages 209-210, PDF pages 235-236

claims.zh_tw: 若要求 saved value，但 controller 不支援 saved value 或尚無 saved value，controller 會以 default value 運作。這不是『讀取成功就代表曾經儲存』。
claims.en: If a saved value is requested but saved values are unsupported or none exists, the controller operates using the default value. A successful read therefore does not prove that a value was previously saved.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.12, 文件頁 210, PDF 頁 236
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.12, printed pages 210, PDF pages 236

claims.zh_tw: CDW14.UIDX 只有在 controller 支援 UUID List 且該 Feature 需要 UUID 關聯時才有意義；未使用時保留為 0。
claims.en: CDW14.UIDX is meaningful only when the controller supports the UUID List and the Feature uses a UUID association; otherwise it remains zero.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.12, 文件頁 210, PDF 頁 236
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.12, printed pages 210, PDF pages 236

claims.zh_tw: SEL=011b 時，CQE.DW0 以 CHANG、NSSPEC、SVBL 回報是否可變更、是否 namespace-specific、是否可 save。這三個 capability bits 與 Feature value 是兩種不同資料，不能混解。
claims.en: With SEL=011b, CQE.DW0 reports CHANG, NSSPEC, and SVBL: changeable, namespace-specific, and saveable. These capability bits are distinct from the Feature value and must not be decoded as one.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.12.1, printed pages 211-212, PDF pages 237-238

claims.zh_tw: 若 Get Features 指定不適用的 Controller Identifier，command-specific status 1Fh 是 Invalid Controller Identifier。Debug 要同時保存 SCT、SC、DNR、CDW10、CDW14 與 target controller。
claims.en: If Get Features specifies an inapplicable Controller Identifier, command-specific status 1Fh is Invalid Controller Identifier. Debug evidence retains SCT, SC, DNR, CDW10, CDW14, and the target controller.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.12.2, 文件頁 212, PDF 頁 238
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.12.2, printed pages 212, PDF pages 238

claims.zh_tw: Set Features 的 DPTR 只在所選 Feature 定義 data structure 時使用。以 PRP 指向 buffer 時，該 data buffer 不得跨越超過一個 memory page boundary，因 PRP2 不能在此指向 PRP List。
claims.en: Set Features uses DPTR only when the selected Feature defines a data structure. With PRPs, that data buffer shall not cross more than one memory-page boundary because PRP2 cannot point to a PRP List here.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30, printed pages 456-457, PDF pages 482-483

claims.zh_tw: CDW10.SV=1 要求把值保存為跨 reset／power cycle 可用的 saved value；若 Feature 不可 save，controller 會回 Feature Identifier Not Saveable。先讀 SVBL，再決定是否設 SV。
claims.en: CDW10.SV=1 requests a saved value that can persist across reset/power-cycle boundaries. If the Feature is not saveable, the controller returns Feature Identifier Not Saveable. Read SVBL before setting SV.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30, 文件頁 457, PDF 頁 483
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30, printed pages 457, PDF pages 483

claims.zh_tw: Set Features 成功後，後續 commands 必須（shall）使用新設定。若軟體需要讓一批 commands 一致套用舊值或新值，host 宜（should）先讓既有 in-flight commands 完成，再切換。
claims.en: After Set Features succeeds, subsequent commands shall use the new setting. If software needs a batch of commands to use one consistent setting, the host should allow existing in-flight commands to complete before switching.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30, 文件頁 459, PDF 頁 485
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30, printed pages 459, PDF pages 485

claims.zh_tw: 本報告五個 FID 的 scope 都是 Controller。FID 02h、04h、0Ch、11h 不支援 save；FID 10h 支援 save。只有 FID 0Ch 需要 256-byte data structure。
claims.en: All five FIDs in this report have Controller scope. FIDs 02h, 04h, 0Ch, and 11h are not saveable; FID 10h is saveable. Only FID 0Ch uses a 256-byte data structure.
claims.heading_en: Scope and persistence of the five FIDs
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30, printed pages 457-459, PDF pages 483-485

claims.zh_tw: controller 必須（shall）至少支援一個 power state，最多可（may）支援 32 個，編號從 0 連續排列。PS0 的 maximum power 最高；後續 state 的 maximum power 不得高於前一個 state。
claims.en: A controller shall support at least one power state and may support up to 32, numbered contiguously from zero. PS0 has the highest maximum power; each subsequent state's maximum power does not exceed the preceding state.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.19, printed pages 666-667, PDF pages 692-693

claims.zh_tw: Power State Descriptor（PSD）把 maximum power、operational/non-operational、entry/exit latency、idle/active power 與 relative performance 放在同一份描述。MP 是 sustained maximum；IDLP 與 ACTP 是不同測量情境，不能拿單次瞬間功耗互相比。
claims.en: A Power State Descriptor (PSD) combines maximum power, operational/non-operational type, entry/exit latency, idle/active power, and relative performance. MP is a sustained maximum; IDLP and ACTP use different measurement conditions and are not interchangeable with an instantaneous sample.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.19, printed pages 666-668, PDF pages 692-694

claims.zh_tw: 從舊 state 直接切到新 state 的最大 transition time，是舊 state 的 EXLAT 加上新 state 的 ENLAT。若 controller 內部經過多個 state，則每一段 transition time 相加。
claims.en: The maximum direct-transition time from an old state to a new state is the old state's EXLAT plus the new state's ENLAT. If a controller transitions through multiple states, the transition times for every segment are summed.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.19.1, printed pages 668-669, PDF pages 694-695

claims.zh_tw: Relative Read／Write Throughput 與 Latency 都是『值越小越好』，但只可在相同 characteristic 內比較；throughput code 不能與 latency code 混成一個總分。
claims.en: Relative Read/Write Throughput and Latency use smaller-is-better encodings, but comparisons are valid only within the same characteristic. A throughput code and a latency code are not combined into one score.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.19.2, 文件頁 668, PDF 頁 694
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.19.2, printed pages 668, PDF pages 694

claims.zh_tw: non-operational power state 不處理 I/O commands，但仍可能處理 property、PMR、CMB、Admin／background 或 transport-specific access。『non-operational』不是 controller 關機。
claims.en: A non-operational power state does not process I/O commands, but may still service properties, PMR, CMB, Admin/background work, or transport-specific accesses. Non-operational does not mean the controller is powered off.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.19, printed pages 667-668, PDF pages 693-694

claims.zh_tw: host 在手動切入 non-operational state 前宜（should）先 drain I/O。若 I/O command 到達，controller 會自主回到最近使用的 operational state，再處理 I/O。
claims.en: The host should drain I/O before manually entering a non-operational state. If an I/O command arrives, the controller autonomously returns to the most recently used operational state before processing I/O.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.19, 文件頁 668, PDF 頁 694
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.19, printed pages 668, PDF pages 694

claims.zh_tw: FID 02h 用 CDW11.PS[4:0] 選 power state、WH[7:5] 提供 workload hint。指定的 PS 必須（shall）在 Identify Controller.NPSS 宣告範圍內；不支援的 PS 應（should）以 Invalid Field in Command 中止。
claims.en: FID 02h uses CDW11.PS[4:0] to select a power state and WH[7:5] for a workload hint. PS shall be within the range advertised by Identify Controller.NPSS; an unsupported PS should be aborted with Invalid Field in Command.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30.1.2, printed pages 460-461, PDF pages 486-487

claims.zh_tw: WH=000b 表示未知 workload；001b 對應先 idle、再做 32 筆 random 1 MiB writes、再 idle 的情境；010b 對應 80,000 筆 sequential 128 KiB writes。011b～111b reserved。
claims.en: WH=000b means unknown workload; 001b represents idle, 32 random 1-MiB writes, then idle; 010b represents 80,000 sequential 128-KiB writes. Encodings 011b through 111b are reserved.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.19.3, 文件頁 669, PDF 頁 695
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.19.3, printed pages 669, PDF pages 695

claims.zh_tw: RTD3E 與 RTD3R 分別描述進入與恢復時間，供 PCIe D3cold 使用情境評估 idle break-even；NVMe 文字明確說這不是 D3hot 的時間。PCIe D-state 的完整原始行為不在目前提供來源內，不能據此自行補寫。
claims.en: RTD3E and RTD3R describe entry and resume time for evaluating idle break-even in a PCIe D3cold use case; the NVMe text explicitly says these are not D3hot times. Complete PCIe D-state semantics are not present in the supplied source and are not invented here.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.19.4, printed pages 669-670, PDF pages 695-696

claims.zh_tw: FID 04h 可為 Composite Temperature 與最多八個實作的 temperature sensors 設 over／under threshold。溫度以 Kelvin 編碼；到達 over threshold 或低於等於 under threshold 時，SMART/Health 的 Temperature Threshold critical warning 可能觸發 asynchronous event。
claims.en: FID 04h sets over/under thresholds for Composite Temperature and up to eight implemented temperature sensors. Temperature is encoded in Kelvin; reaching an over threshold or falling to/below an under threshold may set the SMART/Health Temperature Threshold critical warning and trigger an asynchronous event.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30.1.3, printed pages 462-463, PDF pages 488-489

claims.zh_tw: Figure 470 的 TMPSEL 選 sensor、THSEL 選 over/under、TMPTH 是 threshold、TMPTHH 是 hysteresis。over event 在溫度降到 threshold−hysteresis 時結束；under event在溫度升到 threshold+hysteresis 時結束。
claims.en: In Figure 470, TMPSEL selects a sensor, THSEL selects over/under, TMPTH is the threshold, and TMPTHH is hysteresis. An over event ends at threshold minus hysteresis; an under event ends at threshold plus hysteresis.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30.1.3.1, printed pages 463-464, PDF pages 489-490

claims.zh_tw: FID 0Ch 的 APSTE=1 啟用 Autonomous Power State Transition（APST）；預設值是 0。啟用只表示 controller 可依 APST table 的 idle timer 自主切換，並不保證一定進入任何特定 state。
claims.en: FID 0Ch APSTE=1 enables Autonomous Power State Transition (APST); the default is zero. Enabling it allows controller transitions based on APST-table idle timers; it does not guarantee entry into a particular state.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30.1.7, printed pages 468-469, PDF pages 494-495

claims.zh_tw: APST data structure 固定 256 bytes，共 32 個 8-byte entries。每格 ITPT[31:8] 是毫秒 idle threshold，ITPS[7:3] 是目標 non-operational state；ITPT=0 會停用該 entry。
claims.en: The APST data structure is 256 bytes with 32 eight-byte entries. Each entry uses ITPT[31:8] as the idle threshold in milliseconds and ITPS[7:3] as the target non-operational state; ITPT=0 disables that entry.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30.1.7, printed pages 469, PDF pages 495

claims.zh_tw: APSTE 控制 timer-based entry，NOPPME 控制 controller-initiated background operation 是否可暫時超過 non-operational limit。兩者是兩個正交開關：不要把『可自主進 state』誤解成『可為背景工作提高 power』。
claims.en: APSTE controls timer-based entry, while NOPPME controls whether controller-initiated background operations may temporarily exceed a non-operational limit. These are orthogonal switches; autonomous state entry does not imply permission to raise power for background work.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30.1.7, printed pages 469, PDF pages 495

claims.zh_tw: FID 10h 的 TMT1[31:16] 是較輕度 thermal management threshold，TMT2[15:0] 是較重度 threshold，單位都是 Kelvin；0h 分別停用對應 threshold。
claims.en: FID 10h uses TMT1[31:16] as the lighter thermal-management threshold and TMT2[15:0] as the heavier threshold, both in Kelvin; zero independently disables the corresponding threshold.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30.1.10, printed pages 471-472, PDF pages 497-498

claims.zh_tw: 非零 TMT1 必須（shall）小於 TMT2，且兩者必須落在 MNTMT～MXTMT 內；否則回 Invalid Field in Command。達 TMT1 時 controller 採降低影響的動作，達 TMT2 時採更強動作；hysteresis 由 vendor 決定。
claims.en: A nonzero TMT1 shall be less than TMT2, and both shall lie between MNTMT and MXTMT; otherwise the command returns Invalid Field in Command. At TMT1 the controller acts to minimize impact, while TMT2 invokes stronger action; hysteresis is vendor-specific.

claims.zh_tw: FID 11h 的 NOPPME=1 允許 controller-initiated background operation 暫時把 power 提高到不超過最後一個 operational state 的上限；NOPPME=0 時，這類工作不得超過目前 non-operational state limits。
claims.en: FID 11h NOPPME=1 allows a controller-initiated background operation to raise power temporarily, no higher than the last operational state's limit. With NOPPME=0, such work shall not exceed the current non-operational-state limits.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30.1.11, printed pages 472-473, PDF pages 498-499

claims.zh_tw: 設定完成不是驗證終點。SMART/Health 應同時觀察 Composite Temperature、TTC critical warning、warning temperature time、HCTM transition counters 與已實作 sensor readings，再對照 CQE 與 host latency。
claims.en: Successful configuration is not the end of verification. Observe SMART/Health Composite Temperature, the TTC critical warning, warning-temperature time, HCTM transition counters, and implemented sensor readings together with CQE and host latency.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13.1.3, printed pages 220-225, PDF pages 246-251

claims.zh_tw: 啟動 Device Self-test 前，先讀 Identify Controller：OACS.DSTS 判斷 command 是否支援；EDSTT 是 extended operation 在 power state 0 的名目分鐘數；DSTO.SDSO 決定同時只能有一個 subsystem-wide operation，或每個 controller 各一個。這三個欄位回答不同問題。
claims.en: Before starting Device Self-test, read Identify Controller. OACS.DSTS gates command support, EDSTT gives the nominal extended-operation time in minutes at power state 0, and DSTO.SDSO selects one subsystem-wide operation versus one operation per controller. These fields answer different questions.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 先確認 self-test capability 與 concurrency scope
claims.heading_en: Gate self-test capability and concurrency scope
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14.2.1, 8.1.8, printed pages 352-358, 614, PDF pages 378-384, 640

claims.zh_tw: Device Self-test 由收到 command 的 controller 執行。NSID=00000000h 只測 controller；00000001h～FFFFFFFEh 指定一個 namespace；FFFFFFFFh 包含提交當下可由該 controller 存取的所有 attached namespaces。invalid 與 inactive NSID 會得到不同 status。
claims.en: Device Self-test is performed by the controller that receives the command. NSID 00000000h tests only the controller, 00000001h through FFFFFFFEh select one namespace, and FFFFFFFFh includes every attached namespace accessible through that controller when the operation starts. Invalid and inactive NSIDs produce different status results.
claims.heading_zh_tw: NSID 決定測試涵蓋範圍
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.6, 文件頁 199, PDF 頁 225
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.6, printed pages 199, PDF pages 225

claims.zh_tw: CDW10.STC[3:0] 選動作：1h=short、2h=extended、3h=Host-Initiated Refresh、Eh=vendor specific、Fh=abort；其餘 encoding reserved。只有 STC=Eh 時 CDW15.DSTP 才是 vendor specific，其他情況 CDW15 reserved。
claims.en: CDW10.STC[3:0] selects the action: 1h short, 2h extended, 3h Host-Initiated Refresh, Eh vendor specific, and Fh abort; other encodings are reserved. CDW15.DSTP is vendor specific only when STC is Eh and is reserved otherwise.
claims.heading_zh_tw: STC 與 CDW15 的命令編碼
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.6, printed pages 199-200, PDF pages 225-226

claims.zh_tw: 已有 operation 時，再送 short、extended 或 Host-Initiated Refresh 必須以 Device Self-test in Progress 中止；vendor-specific 新命令的行為仍是 vendor specific。STC=Fh 則依序中止目前 operation、建立最新 result、清除 current status，最後成功完成 command。
claims.en: When an operation is already running, a new short, extended, or Host-Initiated Refresh request is aborted with Device Self-test in Progress; a new vendor-specific request remains vendor specific. STC Fh instead aborts the current operation, creates the newest result, clears current status, and then completes successfully in that order.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 已有 operation 時的狀態矩陣
claims.heading_en: State matrix while an operation is active
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.6, 文件頁 200, PDF 頁 226
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.6, printed pages 200, PDF pages 226

claims.zh_tw: Device Self-test command 的 Admin CQE 只證明『啟動／中止動作已被處理』，不是背景測試已完成。command-specific status 1Dh 表示已有 operation in progress；software 必須把 CQE 與後續 LID 06h 分開記錄。
claims.en: The Admin CQE for Device Self-test proves that the start or abort action was processed, not that the background test finished. Command-specific status 1Dh means an operation is already in progress; software records the CQE separately from later LID 06h evidence.
claims.heading_en: A CQE is not test completion
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.6, 文件頁 201, PDF 頁 227
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.6, printed pages 201, PDF pages 227

claims.zh_tw: Device Self-test 是由 vendor-specific segments 組成的背景工作。若另一個 command 必須暫停測試才能處理，controller 必須（shall）依序 suspend self-test、處理並完成該 command、再 resume self-test；同時可處理哪些 command 則由 vendor 決定。
claims.en: Device Self-test is background work composed of vendor-specific segments. If another command requires suspension, the controller shall suspend the self-test, process and complete that command, and then resume the self-test in order. Which commands may run concurrently remains vendor specific.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 背景測試的 suspend／resume 契約
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.8, 文件頁 614, PDF 頁 640
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.8, printed pages 614, PDF pages 640

claims.zh_tw: short operation 應（should）在兩分鐘內完成，且 Controller Level Reset 會中止；extended operation 應在 EDSTT 內完成，必須跨 Controller Level Reset 與 power restoration 持續並於之後 resume。兩者不能共用同一套 reset 預期。
claims.en: A short operation should finish within two minutes and is aborted by a Controller Level Reset. An extended operation should finish within EDSTT, shall persist across Controller Level Reset and power restoration, and resumes afterward. The two operations cannot share one reset expectation.
claims.heading_zh_tw: short 與 extended 的 reset 差異
claims.heading_en: Reset differences between short and extended tests
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.8.1-8.1.8.2, printed pages 615-616, PDF pages 641-642

claims.zh_tw: short 與 extended 都會被適用的 Format NVM、sanitize start 或 STC=Fh 中止，namespace 從 inventory 移除時則可能（may）中止。Figure 701 顯示 Format 的 NSID 與 secure-erase 選項會改變是否必須中止，不能只看 opcode。
claims.en: Both short and extended operations are aborted by an applicable Format NVM command, sanitize start, or STC Fh, and may be aborted when the namespace is removed from inventory. Figure 701 shows that Format NSID and secure-erase selections affect whether abort is required; the opcode alone is insufficient.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.8.1-8.1.8.2, printed pages 615-616, PDF pages 641-642

claims.zh_tw: 讀取 LID 06h 所需的最小 Get Log Page slice 是：LID=06h、LSP=0、RAE 依事件策略選擇、NUMD 表示 564 bytes、LPOL/LPOU=0、OT=0、CSI=0、UIDX=0。564 bytes=141 dwords，因此 0's-based NUMD=140=008Ch；RAE=0 時 CDW10=008C0006h。
claims.en: The minimum Get Log Page slice for LID 06h uses LID 06h, LSP 0, RAE selected by event policy, NUMD for 564 bytes, LPOL/LPOU 0, OT 0, CSI 0, and UIDX 0. 564 bytes are 141 dwords, so zero-based NUMD is 140 or 008Ch; with RAE 0, CDW10 is 008C0006h.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13, printed pages 213-216, PDF pages 239-242

claims.zh_tw: LID 06h 的 byte 0 以 DSTOS 表示目前 operation，byte 1 的 DSTCS[6:0] 是完成百分比；DSTOS=0 時 host 應忽略 DSTCS。controller 在 operation 完成或被中止時，必須先建立 result entry，之後才能把 in-progress status 清為 0。
claims.en: In LID 06h, byte 0 DSTOS identifies the current operation and byte 1 DSTCS[6:0] is the completion percentage; the host should ignore DSTCS when DSTOS is zero. When an operation completes or is aborted, the controller creates a result entry before clearing in-progress status to zero.
claims.heading_zh_tw: current operation 與完成百分比
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13.1.7, printed pages 229-230, PDF pages 255-256

claims.zh_tw: LID 06h 保留 20 筆、每筆 28 bytes 的結果，RDS1 永遠是最新完成或中止的 operation。未使用 entry 必須讓 DSTR=Fh 且 DSTC=0h，其他欄位由 host 忽略；不能把全零以外的殘值當成歷史結果。
claims.en: LID 06h retains 20 results of 28 bytes each, with RDS1 always the most recently completed or aborted operation. An unused entry uses DSTR Fh and DSTC 0h, while the host ignores its other fields; residual nonzero bytes are not history records.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13.1.7, printed pages 229-230, PDF pages 255-256

claims.zh_tw: 每筆 DSTS 的高 nibble DSTC 表示原始 self-test code，低 nibble DSTR 表示完成／中止原因。只有 DSTR=7h 時 SEGN 才指出第一個失敗 segment；其他 DSTR 下 SEGN 應忽略。
claims.en: In each result DSTS, the high-nibble DSTC records the original self-test code and low-nibble DSTR records the completion or abort reason. SEGN identifies the first failed segment only when DSTR is 7h and is ignored for other DSTR values.
claims.heading_zh_tw: DSTS 與 SEGN 的條件式解碼
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13.1.7, printed pages 231, PDF pages 257

claims.zh_tw: VDINFO 的 NSIDVLD、FVLD、SCTVLD、SCVLD 是四個獨立 validity gates。NSID、FLBA、STCT、STC 只有在對應 bit=1 時才可解讀；先驗證 validity，再讀數值，不能用非零值猜測有效。
claims.en: VDINFO NSIDVLD, FVLD, SCTVLD, and SCVLD are independent validity gates. NSID, FLBA, STCT, and STC are interpreted only when their corresponding bit is one; validate the bit before the value instead of inferring validity from nonzero data.
claims.heading_zh_tw: VDINFO 是四個獨立 validity gates
claims.heading_en: VDINFO contains four independent validity gates
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13.1.7, printed pages 231-232, PDF pages 257-258

claims.zh_tw: Base 將 Figure 219 的 FLBA 留給 I/O Command Set 定義。NVM Command Set 1.3 規定 bytes 23:16 是造成失敗的 logical block address；若有多個失敗 logical blocks，只回其中一個，且僅 FVLD=1 時有效。
claims.en: Base leaves Figure 219 FLBA to the applicable I/O Command Set. NVM Command Set 1.3 defines bytes 23:16 as the logical block address that caused the failure; when multiple logical blocks fail, only one is reported, and it is valid only when FVLD is one.
claims.heading_zh_tw: NVM Command Set 補完 FLBA 語意
claims.heading_en: NVM Command Set completes FLBA semantics
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §4.1.4.3, 文件頁 76, PDF 頁 76
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §4.1.4.3, printed pages 76, PDF pages 76

claims.zh_tw: Debug 時把 command、current state 與歷史 result 分成三個時間點：保存 STC／NSID／CQE；輪詢 DSTOS／DSTCS；完成後保存 DSTS、SEGN、VDINFO、POH、NSID、FLBA、STCT、STC 與 vendor bytes。這樣才能分辨 command rejection、operation abort 與 media failure。
claims.en: Debugging separates command, current state, and historical result into three timestamps: retain STC/NSID/CQE, poll DSTOS/DSTCS, and after completion retain DSTS, SEGN, VDINFO, POH, NSID, FLBA, STCT, STC, and vendor bytes. This distinguishes command rejection, operation abort, and media failure.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 以三個時間點重建 self-test

claims.zh_tw: HMPRE=0 表示 HMB 不支援；非零時以 4 KiB units 表示 preferred size，HMMIN 表示 minimum request。HMMINDS 與 HMMAXD 是 descriptor 限制。即使 host 無法提供 HMB，controller 仍必須（shall）正常運作。
claims.en: HMPRE zero means HMB is unsupported; a nonzero value is the preferred size in 4-KiB units, while HMMIN gives the minimum request. HMMINDS and HMMAXD constrain descriptors. The controller shall still function correctly when the host cannot provide HMB.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14.2.1, 8.2.4, printed pages 357, 362, 744, PDF pages 383, 388, 770

claims.zh_tw: HMB 是 host 配置、controller 專用的記憶體租約。Set Features enable 成功後，host 必須（shall）停止寫入 descriptor list 與所有描述的 memory ranges，直到 disable command 完成；這是 ownership transfer，不只是 performance hint。
claims.en: HMB is host-allocated memory leased exclusively to the controller. After successful Set Features enable, the host shall stop writing both the descriptor list and every described memory range until disable completes. This is an ownership transfer, not merely a performance hint.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30.2.3, 8.2.4, printed pages 515-516, 744, PDF pages 541-542, 770

claims.zh_tw: Set Features 使用 FID=0Dh；CDW11 放 EHM、MR、HMNARE，CDW12 放 HSIZE，CDW13／14 組成 64-bit HMDL address，CDW15 是 HMDLEC。HMDL address 必須 16-byte aligned；HMDLEC=0 必須回 Invalid Field in Command。
claims.en: Set Features uses FID 0Dh. CDW11 holds EHM, MR, and HMNARE; CDW12 holds HSIZE; CDW13/14 form the 64-bit HMDL address; and CDW15 is HMDLEC. The HMDL address is 16-byte aligned, and HMDLEC zero returns Invalid Field in Command.

claims.zh_tw: HMDL 是連續的 16-byte descriptor array；每個 entry 的 BADD 必須依 CC.MPS memory page size 對齊，BSIZE 以相同 page units 表示連續長度。BSIZE=0 的 entry 由 controller 忽略；HSIZE 應與可用 descriptors 的 page 數相符。
claims.en: HMDL is a contiguous array of 16-byte descriptors. Each entry BADD is aligned to the CC.MPS memory-page size, and BSIZE gives a contiguous length in the same page units. The controller ignores an entry whose BSIZE is zero, and HSIZE is reconciled with the usable descriptor-page total.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30.2.3, printed pages 517-518, PDF pages 543-544

claims.zh_tw: 說明性範例：CC.MPS=0 代表 4 KiB page；HSIZE=64 代表 256 KiB。若 HMDL=00000012_34567000h、HMDLEC=2，CDW13=34567000h、CDW14=00000012h、CDW15=00000002h。兩個 descriptor 各 BSIZE=32 pages 時，合計正好 64 pages。
claims.en: Informative example: CC.MPS zero means a 4-KiB page, so HSIZE 64 means 256 KiB. For HMDL 00000012_34567000h and HMDLEC 2, CDW13 is 34567000h, CDW14 is 00000012h, and CDW15 is 00000002h. Two descriptors of BSIZE 32 pages each total exactly 64 pages.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30.2.3, printed pages 516-518, PDF pages 542-544

claims.zh_tw: HMB 已 enable 時再次送 EHM=1 必須以 Command Sequence Error 中止；尚未 enable 時送 EHM=0 則成功但不做事。disable completion 前 controller 應取回所需資料；CQE 被 posted 後才表示 host 可安全修改或回收 buffer。
claims.en: Reissuing EHM one while HMB is already enabled is aborted with Command Sequence Error; issuing EHM zero while disabled succeeds without action. Before disable completion, the controller should retrieve needed data; only the posted CQE means the host may safely modify or reclaim the buffer.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30.2.3, printed pages 515-516, PDF pages 541-542

claims.zh_tw: Get Features 使用 FID=0Dh；SEL≠supported-capabilities 成功時，CQE.DW0 回 EHM、HMNARE、HMNAR，data buffer 回 4 KiB Attributes data structure，包括 HSIZE、HMDL address 與 HMDLEC。『已啟用』與『目前正在限制 access』是不同狀態。
claims.en: Get Features uses FID 0Dh. On successful SEL other than supported capabilities, CQE.DW0 returns EHM, HMNARE, and HMNAR, while the data buffer returns a 4-KiB Attributes structure containing HSIZE, HMDL address, and HMDLEC. Enabled and currently access-restricted are different states.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Get Features 分開讀 policy 與 state
claims.heading_en: Get Features separates policy from state

claims.zh_tw: HMNARE 只有 Identify.CTRATT.HMBR=1 時可啟用。HMNARE 是 policy，HMNAR 是 controller 此刻是否真的因 non-operational state 而被限制；Admin commands 與其啟動的 background operations 有明文例外。NOPPME 不改變這項 HMB restriction。
claims.en: HMNARE may be enabled only when Identify.CTRATT.HMBR is one. HMNARE is policy, while HMNAR reports whether a non-operational state currently restricts the controller; Admin commands and background operations initiated by them are explicit exceptions. NOPPME does not alter this HMB restriction.
claims.heading_zh_tw: HMNARE 與 HMNAR 不相同
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30.2.3, printed pages 516-519, PDF pages 542-545

claims.zh_tw: HMB 不會跨 Controller Level Reset 保存在 controller。reset 後 host 應重新提供資源；若 MR=1 表示歸還先前內容，size、descriptor-list address、descriptor-list contents 與 HMB contents 必須完全相同。RTD3 前宜先 disable，恢復後再依是否保留內容選 MR。
claims.en: HMB is not persistent in the controller across Controller Level Reset. The host should provide resources again afterward. MR one returns prior contents and requires the exact same size, descriptor-list address, descriptor-list contents, and HMB contents. Disable before RTD3, then select MR according to content preservation on resume.
claims.heading_en: Memory Return after reset or RTD3

claims.zh_tw: 使用 HMB 時發生 surprise removal，controller 必須（shall）確保不造成 data loss 或 data corruption。這不代表 HMB 內容本身具有持久性，而是裝置不得把內部正確性依賴在 host 一定能先走正常 release 流程。
claims.en: During surprise removal while HMB is in use, the controller shall ensure no data loss or data corruption. This does not make HMB contents persistent; it means internal correctness cannot depend on the host always completing the normal release flow.
claims.heading_zh_tw: surprise removal 的資料正確性
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.2.4, 文件頁 744, PDF 頁 770
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.2.4, printed pages 744, PDF pages 770

claims.zh_tw: CAP.DSTRD 的實際間距是 2^(2+DSTRD) bytes。DSTRD=0／2／4 分別得到 4／16／64 bytes；software emulation 可用 64-byte stride 把 doorbells 分散到 cacheline，硬體 NVMe interface 的 expected value 是 0h。
claims.en: CAP.DSTRD produces a spacing of 2^(2+DSTRD) bytes. DSTRD values 0, 2, and 4 yield 4, 16, and 64 bytes; software emulation can use 64-byte spacing to separate doorbells by cacheline, while the expected hardware-interface value is 0h.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.1.4.1, 8.2.3, printed pages 56, 744, PDF pages 82, 770

claims.zh_tw: emulator Debug 不只看 doorbell value，也要保存 CAP.DSTRD、計算後 byte stride、queue identifier、被監看的 cacheline 與 write timestamp。把 encoded DSTRD 直接當 bytes 會讓 queue notification 落到錯誤位址。
claims.en: Emulator debugging retains not only the doorbell value but CAP.DSTRD, computed byte stride, queue identifier, monitored cacheline, and write timestamp. Treating encoded DSTRD directly as bytes places queue notifications at the wrong address.
claims.heading_zh_tw: emulator 的 doorbell 證據鏈
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.2.3, 文件頁 744, PDF 頁 770
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.2.3, printed pages 744, PDF pages 770

claims.zh_tw: standard Vendor Specific command format 是 optional。AVSCC.VSCF 控制 vendor-specific Admin commands；ICSVSCC.SNVSCF 控制 vendor-specific I/O commands。兩個 capability 必須分開讀，不能因其中一個為 1 就假設另一類命令也使用 Figure 94。
claims.en: The standard Vendor Specific command format is optional. AVSCC.VSCF controls vendor-specific Admin commands, while ICSVSCC.SNVSCF controls vendor-specific I/O commands. Read the capabilities independently; one being set does not prove that the other command class uses Figure 94.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Admin 與 I/O vendor format 分開 gate
claims.heading_en: Gate Admin and I/O vendor formats independently
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14.2.1, 8.1.29, printed pages 356, 374, 733, PDF pages 382, 400, 759

claims.zh_tw: Figure 94 保留 common CDW0、NSID、metadata/data pointers 與 CDW12-CDW15，並把 CDW10／11 定義成 NDT／NDM。若 command 不使用 NSID，必須清為 0；invalid NSID 在使用時必須回 Invalid Namespace or Format，inactive NSID 行為仍是 vendor specific。
claims.en: Figure 94 retains common CDW0, NSID, metadata/data pointers, and CDW12-CDW15, while defining CDW10/11 as NDT/NDM. An unused NSID is cleared to zero; an invalid NSID used by the command returns Invalid Namespace or Format, while inactive-NSID behavior remains vendor specific.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §4.1.1, 8.1.29, printed pages 143, 733, PDF pages 169, 759

claims.zh_tw: NDT 與 NDM 是實際 dword 數，不是 0's-based。NDT=00000100h 代表 256 dwords=1024 bytes；driver 可用 NDT／NDM 驗證 application buffer，避免 data 或 metadata transfer overflow。是否支援 standard format 仍先由 VSCF／SNVSCF gate。
claims.en: NDT and NDM are actual dword counts, not zero based. NDT 00000100h means 256 dwords or 1024 bytes; a driver can validate application buffers with NDT/NDM to prevent data or metadata-transfer overflow. VSCF or SNVSCF still gates use of the standard format.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §4.1.1, 8.1.29, printed pages 143, 733, PDF pages 169, 759

claims.zh_tw: 三條流程的共同 Debug 原則是找第一個 broken boundary：self-test 比對 command→current status→result；HMB 比對 capability→descriptor math→ownership→disable CQE；emulation／vendor command 比對 capability encoding→byte count／stride→實際 memory access。
claims.en: All three tracks debug from the first broken boundary: self-test compares command, current status, and result; HMB compares capability, descriptor math, ownership, and disable CQE; emulation/vendor commands compare capability encoding, byte count or stride, and actual memory access.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 從第一個 broken boundary 開始 Debug
claims.heading_en: Debug from the first broken boundary
